title: Even membership count from empty symmetric difference
statement: Let $\alpha$ be a type with decidable equality, let $q$ be a nonnegative integer, and let $S_0,\ldots,S_{q-1}$ be finite subsets of $\alpha$. If their iterated symmetric difference is empty, then for every $x\in\alpha$, the number of these sets that contain $x$ is even.
hypotheses_covered: The iterated symmetric difference of the sets is empty
